sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Alsager are bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season, so Sandbach should fancy their chances despite their inconsistent recent form of loss-win-draw-win-win. This is Sandbach's only fixture in the period.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday in a match that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, welcome Eccleshall in what shapes as an intriguing mid-table encounter between two sides in reasonable form. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community in a local derby on Saturday before Wednesfield travel to Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town host Foley Meir on Saturday in a clash between mid-table sides, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter enduring a concerning run of six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town face New Mills on Saturday with both sides looking to climb away from the lower half of the table. Brereton Social's week begins at home to struggling Widnes Town (bottom with just 2 points), while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-battle clash between two of the division's weakest performers. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between sides vying for mid-table security.
